g.text: On hard images, an earlier target crossing and sustained quality are distinct
DSTRUCT: 34 images / 15 buildings. JOINT K4: 33 images / 15 buildings. Same first-six groups are followed through n = 20.
All registered paths stay in the probability denominator. Missing Q cannot certify a crossing. Q = 80 and 90 are parallel descriptive cutoffs, not official acceptance standards.
